backup.createDesc: Exports your entire vault (database and encrypted files) as a single encrypted .dokassist archive. The backup is encrypted with your master password and includes checksums for verification.

backup.warningBody: This will replace ALL current data with the backup. Type

step1.title: Configure practice details
step1.subtitle: Set up your practice information. This will be used for billing and patient documentation.

step2.title: Configure language model
step2.subtitle: Download a language model for features such as session summaries and report generation.
step2.aboutModel: This model balances quality and performance. It runs locally on your machine, so patient data stays private.
step2.downloadHint: This may take a few minutes depending on your internet connection.
step2.modelReady: The model is ready to use.

step3.title: Import existing data
step3.subtitle: Optionally import patient data from CSV files or a RamDoc backup. You can also do this later from Settings.
step3.optionsSubtitle: Choose how to import your data
step3.importCsvDesc: Import patient records from a CSV file, with automatic column detection for German, French and English headers.
step3.restoreBackupDesc: Restore a complete RamDoc backup archive including patients, sessions and encrypted files.
step3.note: You can skip this step and import data later from Settings. The import features remain available at any time.

step4.title: Welcome to RamDoc
step4.subtitle: Here's a quick overview of the key features to help you get started.
step4.privacyBody: All your data is encrypted at rest using SQLCipher with AES-256. Patient files are stored in an encrypted vault. The language model runs locally on your machine, so patient data never leaves your device. Audit logs track all data access for nDSG compliance.

features.patientsDesc: Create and manage patient records with demographic information, diagnoses, medications and treatment plans.
features.schedulingDesc: Schedule therapy sessions with calendar integration. Track session notes, AMDP data and clinical observations.
features.recordingDesc: Record therapy sessions and generate summaries. All processing happens locally.
features.searchDesc: Find patients, sessions and notes with full-text search. Press Cmd+K to open it from anywhere.
features.reportsDesc: Generate clinical reports, letters and documentation with language model assistance. All data stays on your device.
